meaning: Source/document review attestations, not proof of semantic correctness or issue completion.

agents.review_note: Reviewed both registry declarations, capability policy, public-business Support routing, context and redacted tool evidence. Updated generated tool contracts and observability guidance. Public knowledge shortcuts perform actual scoped reads; existing private role and conversation boundaries remain intact.

auth.review_note: Reviewed added public knowledge skill guidance against unchanged identity, account ownership and OAuth contracts. New public lookups omit credentials and never accept an actor selector; no authentication or session rule changes.

commerce.review_note: Reviewed public product projection changes against existing visible/discover/priceOf contract. Bounded display descriptions and optional safe images add no price authority, checkout mutation, tax calculation or business-storage change; commerce guides remain accurate.

content.review_note: Reviewed public ProductService and BlogService published selection and exclusion of future, draft, retired or private Markdown and paths.

foundation.review_note: Reviewed canonical public projections, strict bounded HTTP inputs and product media normalization against architecture, deployment and new WebMCP guide. Documented public/private boundaries, real-demo comparisons and independent native/polyfill proof without claiming direct external chat installation.

google-tags.review_note: Reviewed shared public head changes against GoogleSiteKitClient integration. Polyfill and typed business discovery scripts are independent of existing verification/meta/gtag output; new frontend skill guidance does not alter tag validation or OAuth behavior.

http-errors.review_note: Reviewed public controller validation and deployment guide against RequestFailureService. Known bad parameters return400 through existing JSON response handling; ordinary failure containment remains unchanged. Corrected live SHA guidance to use the existing actual-checkout endpoint.

interface.review_note: Reviewed shared layout and browser adapters, native/Promise registration handling, cleanup and contact template. Updated frontend skill and public tool guide. Published contact/services remain available without Shop/Blog; ordinary UI and form submissions keep existing behavior.

mail.review_note: The shared backend skill gains a public knowledge section only. Reviewed its added guidance against unchanged queue ownership, transactional recipient rules and SMTP uncertainty documentation; no mail source or delivery contract changes.

mcp-clients.review_note: Compared CLI shopToolDefinition with canonical PublicKnowledgeService product schemas and updated shop documentation for bounded descriptions and safe images. Private MCP grant issuance, revocation, expiry and owner authorization are unchanged.

media.review_note: Public catalogue projection now exports only normalized local raster image paths. Reviewed this against unchanged upload storage and guarded deletion contracts; it neither reads arbitrary files nor changes owner media mutations.

operator-help.review_note: Compared changed contact controller, shared layout and route registry against help dependencies. Public contact facts now have a single explicit source; private Help authorization, guide visibility and actor-owned history are unchanged.

sales-channels.review_note: Checked public product visibility, published navigation destinations and isolated first-party catalogue and policy discovery.

workflow.review_note: Reviewed CI and deployment workflow additions and generated inventories against development and Git skills. Native isolated-world WebMCP and official-polyfill checks are separate required commands; existing exact-head CI and live SHA gates remain intact.
